epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Claim amendment · 2026-11-08T02:19Z

The #31327 card thread read the tree at `origin/main` 604a2b3b9a. The claim's path for driver-sql was wrong, and the card's own Task items need four seams the surface did not list. The same applies to this card.

- File surface (replaces the claim's): `packages/drivers/driver-sql/**` (with the `oracledb` optional peer in its package.json), `pnpm-lock.yaml`; `packages/spec/src/data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts`, a new `packages/spec/src/data/driver/oracle.zod.ts` (the per-id config shape `DRIVER_CONFIG_SCHEMAS` requires) and its `driver/index.ts` export; `packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts` (the managed-mode refusal at `defineStack`); `packages/spec/src/data/type-compat.ts`; their tests and generated artefacts; ADR-0015 §4.6; `packages/services/service-datasource/src/default-datasource-driver-factory.ts` (and `connect-failure-remedy.ts` if needed), so the id is served by driver-sql; the introspection seam the Studio Tables tab and `list_remote_tables` / `import_object` read; `ui/` connection-form types only if Type Check UI reds on the widened `BuiltinDriverId`; `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx` (a Oracle section); `.changeset/**`. Stop on any other breach.
- Live cell env: `OS_TEST_ORACLE_URL` (the `OS_` prefix rule, matching `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`), not the card's bare name.
- Serial constraints: `datasource.zod.ts`, `driver/index.ts` and `default-datasource-driver-factory.ts` join the shared spots with #31327 / #31328. Whichever PR lands second merges main and reconciles.

Clause-② stays `yes` (provisional).

Claim amendment · 2026-11-08T03:22Z

The card thread reported files outside the amended surface. Each one is forced by a ratchet or by the widened driver set, so they are added:
- `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md` and its regenerated `.counts/data.md`: one row for `driver/oracle.zod.ts` (`strictness-ledger.test` requires a row for every new spec schema file).
- `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-credential-migration.ts`: a docblock row only.
- In `packages/services/service-datasource`, three test files: credential-migration, admin-plugin (the unsupported-driver example moves from `oracle` to `db2`), and missing-driver-client-boot-refusal (gains an `oracledb` row).
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/live-dialect-matrix.testkit.ts`: `ORACLE_CELL` is appended at the end of the file. It is inside `packages/drivers/driver-sql/**` already; noted for #31327's reconcile.

Two pre-existing `columnMap` defects found by this thread go to their own cards: #31340 (update/delete/bulkDelete key, aggregate/distinct) and #31342 (upsert, plus the paged-read tie-breaker). This PR merges main after #31340 lands, then drops its duplicate commits.

Clause-② stays `yes` (provisional).

epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Claim amendment · 2026-11-08T04:32Z

PR #31351 CI round 1 touched more files outside the surface. Each one is forced by a gate, a ratchet or the widened driver set, so they are added:
- `scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs`: adds the two Oracle modules to `DECLARED_WATCH_HINTS`.
- `scripts/driver-memory-census.ledger.json`: 3 mock-replacement rows.
- `packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/oracle-datasource-driver-factory.test.ts`: new. It holds the Oracle factory pins that were in `default-datasource-driver-factory.test.ts`, which is now back to `main`.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/driver-vocabulary-parity.test.ts`: one cast.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`.
- `packages/spec/src/data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts` (already on the surface): adds `FederationOnlyDriverId` / `DatabaseSelectionDriverId` types, which keep the runtime's exhaustive switch from seeing `oracle`. That is part of the spec face, and the contract review reads it.

After #31340 landed, the PR merged `main` (27d4697a) and dropped its duplicate commits. Head `4c2b78d4`: +2734/−83, 2817 lines. The paged-read tie-breaker commit stays until #31342 lands.

Clause-② stays `yes` (provisional).

epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Landed · 2026-11-08T08:22Z

PR #31351 merged through the queue as `3aa0b42d59` at 2026-11-08T08:21:55Z. It was Tier H (`docs/adr/**`), approved by os-zhuang (review 5816972719). Its CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER record and delta record (6718048639) were both PASS, and they carried over a merge-forward plus a prose-only regeneration hop (the Regen-provenance line).

`schemaMode: 'external'` datasources can now federate Oracle 12c+ through node-oracledb Thin mode, and Oracle is federation-only: `managed` is refused at parse, and DDL is refused in every mode. The live Oracle 23ai cell passed 261/261.

Follow-ups: #31389 (Studio catalog), #31390 (HEXTORAW uuid binding). The pre-existing defects found here landed separately as #31340 and #31342. #31327 (SQL Server, PR #31381) now reconciles on top of this.
